mbq_sealed_for_now.description: I want you to stand at the Heartwood Hollow behind Heartwatch and listen, so you know what the watch is for. The shadow hunters sealed it, and nobody goes in until the tribes say so. It's the split behind me. Put your ear to the seal, but don't touch it. Then come back and tell me what you heard.
mbq_sealed_for_now.accept_text: Go and stand at the split behind me and put your ear to the seal. Don't touch it, only listen.
